newsitem.title: USA: Revlon to redeem 10-7/8 pct debentures.
newsitem.headline: Revlon to redeem 10-7/8 pct debentures.

text.p: Revlon Inc's Revlon Consumer Products Corp unit said Friday it had called for redemption on July 15 Revlon's 10-7/8 percent sinking fund debentures due 2010.

Revlon said it will redeem $13.5 million of the debentures as an optional sinking fund payment for full principal amount plus accrued interest, and the remainder for 101.46 percent of the principal amount plus accrued interest.
The redemption agent is First Trust National Association of St. Paul, Minn.
